gloss: to arise; to break out; to be stirred up

definitions.gloss: to arise; to break out; to be stirred up
definitions.explanation: For something like controversy, emotion, or phenomena to suddenly arise or develop with momentum.

examples.japanese: その{発言|はつげん}で{大|おお}きな{議論|ぎろん}が{巻|ま}き{起|お}こった。
examples.english: That statement sparked a huge debate.

examples.japanese: {観客席|かんきゃくせき}から{拍手喝采|はくしゅかっさい}が{巻|ま}き{起|お}こった。
examples.english: Applause and cheers erupted from the audience.

examples.japanese: ネットで{批判|ひはん}の{嵐|あらし}が{巻|ま}き{起|お}こった。
examples.english: A storm of criticism arose online.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{巻|ま}き{起|お}こる → {巻|ま}き{起|お}こらない (negative)
・{巻|ま}き{起|お}こる → {巻|ま}き{起|お}こって (te-form)
・{巻|ま}き{起|お}こる → {巻|ま}き{起|お}こった (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {巻|ま}く (to wind/roll) + {起|お}こる (to occur)

The combination suggests something arising with a rolling, sweeping motion.

COLLOCATIONS:
・{議論|ぎろん}が{巻|ま}き{起|お}こる - debate breaks out
・{批判|ひはん}が{巻|ま}き{起|お}こる - criticism arises
・{拍手|はくしゅ}が{巻|ま}き{起|お}こる - applause erupts
・{感動|かんどう}が{巻|ま}き{起|お}こる - emotion wells up

TRANSITIVITY:
{巻|ま}き{起|お}こす is the transitive form meaning 'to stir up, to cause to arise.'
